title: Settings
languageHint: Changes the whole app right away, including the tray menu.
startWithWindows: Start with Windows (minimized to the tray)
closeToTray: Closing the window keeps the RGB running in the tray
gpuHint: Off = lighter (doesn't use the graphics card). Turn it on only if a 3D effect doesn't show up. Applies after reopening the app.
gpuRestart: Quit from the tray icon and open Hydraflow again to apply
pluginFoldersHint: Your own .js plugins (device.* API). The plugins included with the app already cover ASUS Aura and Wooting.
virtualHint: Simulated keyboard and controller, for testing.
